lines: Total assets have grown at approximately 8-10% CAGR over five years, with the single largest step change driven by the Bryn Mawr Trust acquisition (January 1, 2022). Wealth AUM/AUA is in strong acceleration, growing 35% in two years. Core EPS increased 19% year-over-year in FY2025, placing WSFS in the top quartile of the $15-30B regional bank peer group. [E-002, E-003, E-059]

WSFS's financial trajectory is classified as ACCELERATING. The five-year asset CAGR of ~8-10% total assets reflects both the step change from the Bryn Mawr Trust acquisition (January 2022, +$7B) and sustained organic growth. Key acceleration signals: Core EPS +19% YoY (2024→2025); ROA improved from 1.22% to 1.39%; Wealth AUM/AUA grew 35% in two years to $97.4B. WSFS is at KRX 80th percentile versus its defined peer group (2023). [E-002, E-003, E-059]
